messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Some side effects were more common with particular conditions.

Insomnia and agitation were more common in OCD trials.
Constipation and agitation were more common in panic disorder trials.
Tiredness was more common in PTSD trials.
Insomnia, dizziness, tiredness, dry mouth, and a general feeling of being unwell were more common in social anxiety disorder trials.
In PMDD trials, sleepiness, dry mouth, dizziness, tiredness, and stomach pain were more common.
In these trials, 12% of people taking sertraline stopped treatment.
They stopped treatment because of a side effect.
This was compared with 4% of people taking placebo.
The most common reason for stopping was nausea (3%).
Diarrhea (2%) was another common reason for stopping.
Agitation (2%) was also a common reason for stopping.

Sexual side effects of sertraline:
SSRIs including sertraline can cause sexual problems.
In men, sexual problems can mean delayed ejaculation or being unable to ejaculate.

The relation 'has discontinuation rate' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a specified percentage of patients who discontinue treatment.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Choices:
A. 'discontinued rate': The percentage of patients who discontinued the subject drug is specified by the object entity.
B. 'has healing rate': The subject drug is associated with a specific percentage of patients experiencing healing at a specified time.
C. 'may stop treatment if': The subject entity (typically a healthcare provider) may discontinue treatment based on the condition or situation specified by the object entity.
D. 'has eradication rate': The subject therapy achieves the specified rate of eradication of the target condition.
